plugins.name: multi-agent-delegator
plugins.description: Delegate bounded coding work from Claude Code to interactive Codex and Antigravity sessions running in visible cmux terminal panes, while Claude retains architecture, coordination, review, and integration.

plugins.name: graph-blueprint
plugins.description: Run broad tasks as a graph: define the goal, split it, fan out parallel workers on different angles, verify their findings in fresh context, merge what survives, and synthesize one clear report.
